home.title:
Drive part of the way.
Take the train for the rest.
home.lead: Ride and Rail matches you with drivers who are already heading your way, even if they aren't going all the way. They drop you at a station on their route, and a real train or bus connection takes you the rest of the way.
home.step1.title: Drivers share empty seats
home.step1.text: On a trip they're making anyway: where from, where to, when, and how many seats are free.
home.step2.title: Matched along the route
home.step2.text: Not just drivers going to the same town: anyone whose route passes close to you, ranked by how small the detour is for them.
home.step3.title: Finish by train or bus
home.step3.text: If the driver isn't going all the way, you get a drop-off station on their route with a real connection to your destination, from the Swiss public transport timetable.
home.note: Every search also shows the public transport option on its own, so you can compare.
